findings.title: Renamed function breaks existing callers
findings.body: The function was renamed from `readSensor` to `sampleSensor`, but `src/alerts.ts` still imports and calls `readSensor` on line 2. This will cause a runtime `ReferenceError` for any code that relies on the old name. Restore the original name or update all call sites.

summary.problem: Renaming `readSensor` to `sampleSensor` breaks existing callers without updating them.
summary.done_well: The new function signature and implementation remain correct and unchanged.
